title: Kutu (Cuthah), entrance to the underworld in Iraq
place_text: Tell Ibrahim, south-east of Baghdad, Iraq

tellings.quote: and it was a place that was supposed to be the entrance to the underworld. It exists today today in Iraq.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about the occult and secret history, talks about an ancient city called Kutu, also known as Cuthah, at a site now called Tell Ibrahim, south-east of Baghdad in Iraq. He says it was believed to be the entrance to the underworld, that it still exists today, and he connects it to a book of occult lore called the Necronomicon. If true, a real place in modern Iraq would be tied to very old beliefs about a gateway to another realm.
